verse.verse_1: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
verse.verse_2: I worship not that which ye worship,
verse.verse_3: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
verse.verse_4: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
verse.verse_5: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
verse.verse_6: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
